title: Orange5 AtomSmasher Cartridge v0
description: AtomSmasher Cartridge — pre-compiled domain capability unit, hot-swappable into a model session. Bundles a system_prompt (injected into the model's system role), a list of declared capabilities (used by the Least-action Router for eligibility), and an array of tool_cards (typed tool descriptors the model may invoke). Cartridges are inert descriptors; they don't execute anything themselves. cartridge_id = sha256(canonical({name, version, capabilities, system_prompt, tool_cards})). The id is derived, never stored on disk.

name.description: Unique registry key. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must start with a letter and end with letter-or-digit.

version.description: Semver. swap() refuses to apply a same-version replacement; bump version to change content.

summary.description: One-line human-facing description. Not part of cartridge_id; can be refined without churning the id.

capabilities.description: Declared capability ids (dotted, lowercase). Used by the Least-action Router for eligibility. Non-empty.

system_prompt.description: The text injected into the model's system role when this cartridge is mounted. Should be terse and operational; no chatty preamble.

tool_cards.description: Typed tool descriptors. The model is told these exist; the gateway / tool-runner actually invokes them. Each card has a unique name within the cartridge.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema fragment describing the tool's input. Validated as an object only — full per-tool semantics are the tool-runner's responsibility.

tags.description: Optional human-facing tags. Not part of cartridge_id.
